cases.note: An unfinished quoted uses value keeps its YAML error rather than producing a metadata comment.
Rust's ASCII whitespace definition excludes vertical tab: https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/primitive.u8.html#method.is_ascii_whitespace.

cases.source_utf8:
jobs:
  check:
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2
      - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # master
# ordinary note
cases.note: Renovate reads the version or branch beside a full action pin: https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/github-actions/.

expect.output_utf8:
jobs:
  check:
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2
      - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # master

cases.source_utf8:
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: 'owner/repo/path@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1' # release/v2
    - "uses" : "owner/repo@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef" # v2
# ordinary note
cases.note: A composite action can use quoted keys, quoted values, and a repository subpath.

expect.output_utf8:
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: 'owner/repo/path@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1' # release/v2
    - "uses" : "owner/repo@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef" # v2

cases.source_utf8:
steps:
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2.1.0 because the API is stable
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # prefix/v2.1.0 because the API is stable
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # pin v2.1.0
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # tag = v2.1.0
# ordinary note
cases.note: Version metadata remains machine input when its comment also carries an explanation.

expect.output_utf8:

  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # prefix/v2.1.0 because the API is stable
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # pin v2.1.0
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # tag = v2.1.0

cases.source_utf8:
steps:
  - uses: owner/repo@v2 # v2
  - uses: owner/repo@abc1234 # v2
  - run: echo owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2
  - uses: ./local@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2
  - uses: docker://image@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # ordinary prose
# master
cases.note: A reference word alone supplies no action context, and a non-pinned value supplies no full digest.

steps:

  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # branch.lock
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # main branch
  - uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 #
cases.note: Reference-shaped metadata follows the one-level Git reference naming rules.
Action metadata belongs to the tool-directive tier, which the all policy can remove.
A byte-order mark and CRLF do not change the same-line pin context.

cases.source_utf8:
steps:
  - uses: "owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2" # ordinary note
  - run: |
      uses: owner/repo@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v2
# ordinary note
cases.note: Text inside a quoted or block scalar does not create a YAML comment annotation.
